ValidationRule.description: An ask names one person or one organization (canonical model R-SO1). Checked on create and when a donor field changes only, so an ask whose donor was deleted can still be closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Donor_Contact__c), ISCHANGED(Donor_Account__c) ), OR( AND( ISBLANK(Donor_Contact__c), ISBLANK(Donor_Account__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Donor_Contact__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Donor_Account__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Choose one person or one organization for this ask, not both and not neither.
